presence.status: Explicit scenario priors. No comparable measured Portuguese commercial occupancy series found. Staff shifts, client turnover and persistent residents are separate processes; energy noise cannot generate people.
presence.care_visiting_status: Explicit 10:00-20:00 scenario prior, independent of 24/7 residents and staff. No claim of Portuguese regulatory or population visiting hours.

commercial.between_building_status: Log-space population standard deviation of the small published Portuguese audit values for retail/cafe/grocery; descriptive only and attenuated by transfer weight. Other sectors 0.30, office 0.25 are scenario priors. Stable by physical member across years; not nationally estimated dispersion.

evaluation_protocol.revision_method: Portugal-realism-4: published Portuguese annual means as calibration anchors, independent discrete attendance, cold-water professional laundry engineering model, whole-building budget including all programmes once. No new heldout data: existing BDG2/REFIT/FIK observations already examined in realism-3. Repeated comparison is a regression/diagnostic, not fresh validation. Do not tune on these comparisons.
evaluation_protocol.unvalidated: Occupancy rates/densities/dwell, laundry throughput/partial-load/duration transfer, professional catering batch counts, Portuguese clinic/workshop/sports/care annual intensity.
evaluation_protocol.post_first_diagnostic_correction: After first realism-4 diagnostic: corrected near-identical sector annual EUI by adding stable between-site dispersion; office/workshop individual working day now 7.5-9h within longer public opening. No fitting to BDG2/REFIT/FIK comparisons; Portuguese audit dispersion is descriptive calibration information.
evaluation_protocol.care_visiting_correction: Final structural review: resident/staff 24h service must not imply overnight public visits. Explicit daytime visiting prior introduced; repeat all dependent checks.

seed_sensitivity.scope: 20 seeds x 8 commercial sectors, two-year exogenous commercial end-use generator, physical normal-service envelopes; no native simulation. 72 paired OAT configurations x 8 sectors, including Portuguese transfer weights and attendance. seed_sensitivity.infeasibility_policy: Default seeds must be feasible and have no exact daily copies. No hardware changes.

commercial.parameter_status: BDG2 development-only sector medians; partial transfer is an explicit prior, not a Portuguese population fit. Grocery has no development building: all its anchors are scenario priors. Area-based expected presence is a proxy. Hourly reference does not validate sub-hour process dynamics.

prior_evaluation_protocol.commercial_adjustment: Development BDG2 sector median hourly anchors. Energy: geometric half-transfer from the original EUI; shape: 0.65 linear transfer of night/day ratio into background prior. Neither weight is estimated from Portugal; sensitivity includes energy transfer 0/1 and shape 0.4/0.9. Sector activity peaks, attendance density and sub-hour fluctuations are explicit priors. Grocery has no development meter.
prior_evaluation_protocol.appliance_adjustment: House-balanced whole detected REFIT candidates from houses 3/5, jointly retaining energy/duration/shape, 48 variants per domestic/staff machine; bounded small energy perturbation. Installed nominal rating respected without deleting energy. Frequency/deadlines remain household inventory priors, professional laundry remains an unvalidated equipment prior. Catering warm-up/holding is reclassified from background to a named non-shiftable end use; short aggregated batch energy/frequency are explicit priors, not fitted or annotated professional cycles.
prior_evaluation_protocol.evaluation: Hold out BDG2 physical buildings and REFIT houses 2/11. Compare all sectors and both years, by building/house rather than pooling every sample. Report every discrepancy; no post-hoc fit or pass thresholds based on heldout observations.

portuguese_revision.inference_limit: Published Portuguese summaries inform scenario assumptions, not independent population validation. No measured commercial occupancy or professional workload series were fitted. Clinics, workshops, sports centres and care homes still lack comparable Portuguese annual anchors. Grocery reference sites are much smaller; generic health/beauty is not a clinic and a print shop is not an industrial factory.
